## Loop Over All Hi-C Data Files

```{r plot-hic-loop, fig.width=7, fig.height=6.5}
library(plotgardener)

# Override the boundary cutoff check to allow STON1 and other boundary labels to be drawn in small plots
ns_pg <- asNamespace("plotgardener")
unlockBinding("cutoffLabel", ns_pg)
assign("cutoffLabel", function(df, fontsize, xscale, vp, unit) {
    return(as.character(df[1]))
}, envir = ns_pg)

# Override textGrob inside the grid package namespace to force check.overlap = FALSE so overlapping labels print
ns_grid <- asNamespace("grid")
current_textGrob <- get("textGrob", envir = ns_grid)
if (is.null(attr(current_textGrob, "original_fun"))) {
    original_textGrob <- current_textGrob
} else {
    original_textGrob <- attr(current_textGrob, "original_fun")
}
override_textGrob <- function(...) {
    args <- list(...)
    args$check.overlap <- FALSE
    do.call(original_textGrob, args)
}
attr(override_textGrob, "original_fun") <- original_textGrob
unlockBinding("textGrob", ns_grid)
assign("textGrob", override_textGrob, envir = ns_grid)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Configuration & Directories
# ==============================================================================
# Load custom MANE select genome build
library(GenomicFeatures)
mane_gff_path <- "../data/STON1_locus/MANE.GRCh38.v1.5.refseq_genomic.gff.gz"
if (!file.exists(mane_gff_path)) stop("MANE GFF file not found!")

message("Loading MANE Select GFF database...")
txdb_mane <- makeTxDbFromGFF(mane_gff_path, format = "gff")
seqlevelsStyle(txdb_mane) <- "UCSC"

# Create custom assembly pointing to the MANE Select database
custom_assembly <- assembly(
    Genome = "hg38_mane",
    TxDb = txdb_mane,
    OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
    gene.id.column = "SYMBOL",
    display.column = "SYMBOL"
)

# Genomic region of interest (~1.25 Mb)
chrom <- "chr2"
start_pos <- 47361610
end_pos <- 48613291

region_params <- pgParams(
    chrom      = chrom,
    chromstart = start_pos,
    chromend   = end_pos,
    assembly   = custom_assembly
)

# 2.2Mb region configuration (Approx 2Mb region with padding)
start_pos_2Mb <- 46533132 - 100000
end_pos_2Mb <- 48533132 + 100000

region_params_2Mb <- pgParams(
    chrom      = chrom,
    chromstart = start_pos_2Mb,
    chromend   = end_pos_2Mb,
    assembly   = custom_assembly
)

# Input and output directories
mcool_dir <- "../data/hi_c/mcool"

# List all .mcool files in the RAW folder
mcool_files <- list.files(path = mcool_dir, pattern = "\\.mcool$", full.names = TRUE)

# CTCF BED data directory and files
bed_dir <- "../data/hi_c/CTCF_data"
bed_files <- list.files(path = bed_dir, pattern = "\\.bed$", full.names = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# Helper Function to Draw the Small Plot (no BED tracks, 7pt font, 2.08 x 3 in)
# ==============================================================================
draw_hic_plot_small <- function(mcool_path, sample_name, reg_params, s_pos, e_pos) {
    # CRITICAL FIX: Comment out this line to stop the double-rendering haze!
    # pageCreate(width = 3.0, height = 4.0, default.units = "inches", showGuides = FALSE)

    # Ensure RColorBrewer is available
    if (!requireNamespace("RColorBrewer", quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages("RColorBrewer", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    }

    # Plot the Hi-C Triangle Heatmap (Width = 2.6, Height = 1.3)
    hic_plot <- plotHicTriangle(
        data = mcool_path,
        params = reg_params,
        resolution = 5000,
        norm = "BALANCE", # Normalization method
        x = 0.2,
        y = 0.6,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.3,
        zrange = c(0, 2000),
        palette = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 9, "YlGnBu"))
    )

    # Add the sample title text (fontsize = 7)
    plotText(
        label = sample_name,
        x = 1.5,
        y = 0.35,
        just = "center",
        fontsize = 7,
        fontface = "bold"
    )

    # Highlight genomic coordinate chr2:48530164 (up-left diagonal)
    annoSegments(
        plot = hic_plot,
        x0 = 48530164,
        y0 = 0,
        x1 = (s_pos + 48530164) / 2,
        y1 = (48530164 - s_pos) / (2 * 5000),
        default.units = "native",
        linecolor = "black",
        lwd = 0.8,
        lty = 2
    )

    # Highlight genomic coordinate chr2:47403156 (up-right diagonal)
    annoSegments(
        plot = hic_plot,
        x0 = 47403156,
        y0 = 0,
        x1 = (e_pos + 47403156) / 2,
        y1 = (e_pos - 47403156) / (2 * 5000),
        default.units = "native",
        linecolor = "black",
        lwd = 0.8,
        lty = 2
    )

    # Add the Genome Axis (fontsize = 7)
    plotGenomeLabel(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.0,
        length = 2.6,
        fontsize = 7
    )

    # Two-pass gene track rendering to layer STON1 (blue) on top of STON1-GTF2A1L (grey):
    # Pass 1: Plot all genes in grey with grey labels, except MSH2 which is blue (blue label)
    gene_highlights_1 <- data.frame(
        gene = "MSH2",
        color = "black",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plotGenes(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.2,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.2,
        fontsize = 1,
        geneHighlights = gene_highlights_1,
        geneBackground = "grey",
        fontcolor = c("grey", "grey")
    )

    # Pass 2: Overplot STON1 in blue (blue label), with all other genes & labels transparent,
    # and turn off strand labels to avoid duplicate drawing.
    gene_highlights_2 <- data.frame(
        gene = "STON1",
        color = "black",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plotGenes(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.2,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.2,
        fontsize = 1,
        geneHighlights = gene_highlights_2,
        geneBackground = "#00000000",
        fontcolor = c("#00000000", "#00000000"),
        strandLabels = FALSE
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Loop for Small 2.2Mb Region (Fixed Viewport Alignment)
# ==============================================================================
output_dir_small <- "./outputs_hic_analysis/final_paper_approx_2Mb_hi_c_plots_small"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir_small)) {
    dir.create(output_dir_small, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Ensure the ragg package is available for crisp, vibrant PNGs
if (!requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("ragg", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

for (mcool_path in mcool_files) {
    filename <- basename(mcool_path)
    sample_name <- gsub("-Arima-allReps-filtered\\.mcool$", "", filename)

    pdf_path <- file.path(output_dir_small, paste0(sample_name, ".pdf"))
    png_path <- file.path(output_dir_small, paste0(sample_name, ".png"))

    message(paste("Processing clean-vector small plots for:", sample_name))

    # 1. Save to Clean Vector PDF
    cairo_pdf(pdf_path, width = 3, height = 4)
    # Initialize the plotgardener page EXACTLY once on top of the Cairo engine canvas
    pageCreate(width = 3.0, height = 4.0, default.units = "inches", showGuides = FALSE)
    draw_hic_plot_small(mcool_path, sample_name, region_params_2Mb, start_pos_2Mb, end_pos_2Mb)
    dev.off()

    # 2. Save to Matched PNG via ragg
    ragg::agg_png(png_path, width = 3, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300, background = "white")
    # Initialize the plotgardener page EXACTLY once on top of the AGG engine canvas
    pageCreate(width = 3.0, height = 4.0, default.units = "inches", showGuides = FALSE)
    draw_hic_plot_small(mcool_path, sample_name, region_params_2Mb, start_pos_2Mb, end_pos_2Mb)
    dev.off()
}
```

## Loop for Small 2.2Mb Region with Knight-Ruiz (BALANCE) Rasterized Normalization

```{r plot-hic-loop-small-rasterized, fig.width=3, fig.height=4}
# ==============================================================================
# 6. Loop for Small 2.2Mb Region with Knight-Ruiz (BALANCE) Rasterized Normalization
# ==============================================================================
output_dir_small_rasterized <- "./outputs_hic_analysis/final_paper_approx_2Mb_hi_c_plots_small/FINAL_PLOTS_RASTERIZED"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(output_dir_small_rasterized)) {
    dir.create(output_dir_small_rasterized, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper Function specifically for BALANCE normalization with self-contained rasterization
# ==============================================================================
draw_hic_plot_small_rasterized <- function(mcool_path, sample_name, reg_params, s_pos, e_pos) {
    # Ensure png library is available
    if (!requireNamespace("png", quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages("png", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    }

    # 1. Generate the rasterized heatmap and annotation lines on a temporary PNG device
    tmp_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

    # Open transparent background PNG device at page size and 600 DPI
    png(tmp_png, width = 3.0, height = 4.0, units = "in", res = 600, bg = "transparent")

    # Initialize the page layout on the PNG device
    pageCreate(width = 3.0, height = 4.0, default.units = "inches", showGuides = FALSE)

    # Plot the Hi-C Triangle Heatmap natively onto the PNG canvas
    hic_plot <- plotHicTriangle(
        data = mcool_path,
        params = reg_params,
        resolution = 5000,
        norm = "BALANCE", # Normalization method
        x = 0.2,
        y = 0.6,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.3,
        zrange = c(0, 50),
        palette = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red")),
        draw = TRUE
    )

    # Highlight genomic coordinate chr2:48530164 (up-left diagonal) - rendered to PNG
    annoSegments(
        plot = hic_plot,
        x0 = 48530164,
        y0 = 0,
        x1 = (s_pos + 48530164) / 2,
        y1 = (48530164 - s_pos) / (2 * 5000),
        default.units = "native",
        linecolor = "black",
        lwd = 0.8,
        lty = 2
    )

    # Highlight genomic coordinate chr2:47403156 (up-right diagonal) - rendered to PNG
    annoSegments(
        plot = hic_plot,
        x0 = 47403156,
        y0 = 0,
        x1 = (e_pos + 47403156) / 2,
        y1 = (e_pos - 47403156) / (2 * 5000),
        default.units = "native",
        linecolor = "black",
        lwd = 0.8,
        lty = 2
    )
    dev.off()

    # Read the transparent PNG back in
    img <- png::readPNG(tmp_png)

    # Create a rasterGrob covering the entire page using NPC coordinates
    # This centers the raster exactly on the page, completely avoiding
    # any reversed y-axis or unit conversion direction issues in the viewport.
    hic_raster <- grid::rasterGrob(img,
        x = 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        width = 1.0,
        height = 1.0,
        just = "center",
        default.units = "npc"
    )

    # 2. Draw everything to the main active device (PDF or PNG)
    # Initialize the main canvas page
    pageCreate(width = 3.0, height = 4.0, default.units = "inches", showGuides = FALSE)

    # Draw the rasterized Hi-C heatmap and annotation lines onto the main page
    grid::grid.draw(hic_raster)

    # Add the sample title text (fontsize = 7)
    plotText(
        label = sample_name,
        x = 1.5,
        y = 0.35,
        just = "center",
        fontsize = 7,
        fontface = "bold"
    )

    # Add the Genome Axis (fontsize = 7)
    plotGenomeLabel(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.0,
        length = 2.6,
        fontsize = 7
    )

    # Two-pass gene track rendering to layer STON1 (black) on top of STON1-GTF2A1L (grey):
    # Pass 1: Plot all genes in grey with grey labels, except MSH2 which is black (black label)
    gene_highlights_1 <- data.frame(
        gene = "MSH2",
        color = "black",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plotGenes(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.2,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.2,
        fontsize = 1,
        geneHighlights = gene_highlights_1,
        geneBackground = "grey",
        fontcolor = c("grey", "grey")
    )

    # Pass 2: Overplot STON1 in black (black label), with all other genes & labels transparent,
    # and turn off strand labels to avoid duplicate drawing.
    gene_highlights_2 <- data.frame(
        gene = "STON1",
        color = "black",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    plotGenes(
        params = reg_params,
        x = 0.2,
        y = 2.2,
        width = 2.6,
        height = 1.2,
        fontsize = 1,
        geneHighlights = gene_highlights_2,
        geneBackground = "#00000000",
        fontcolor = c("#00000000", "#00000000"),
        strandLabels = FALSE
    )
}

# Run the loop to generate the new BALANCE-normalized rasterized plots
for (mcool_path in mcool_files) {
    # Extract file basename and the sample name
    filename <- basename(mcool_path)
    sample_name <- gsub("-Arima-allReps-filtered\\.mcool$", "", filename)

    # Paths
    pdf_path <- file.path(output_dir_small_rasterized, paste0(sample_name, ".pdf"))
    png_path <- file.path(output_dir_small_rasterized, paste0(sample_name, ".png"))

    # Print status message
    message(paste("Processing BALANCE-normalized RASTERIZED small 2.2Mb region plots for:", sample_name))

    # 1. Save to PDF (width = 3, height = 4)
    pdf(pdf_path, width = 3, height = 4)
    draw_hic_plot_small_rasterized(mcool_path, sample_name, region_params_2Mb, start_pos_2Mb, end_pos_2Mb)
    dev.off()

    # 2. Save to PNG (width = 3, height = 4 with 300 DPI resolution)
    png(png_path, width = 3, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
    draw_hic_plot_small_rasterized(mcool_path, sample_name, region_params_2Mb, start_pos_2Mb, end_pos_2Mb)
    dev.off()
}
```
